notes.title: Eons Away Playtest is now live!
notes.notes:
The second round of playtesting for Eons Away is now live!

To join, simply request access through the Eons Away Steam store page. The playtest will be open until April 4th!

If you're able to, please record your playthrough and send it to me. Your feedback will greatly assist in refining the game. Additionally, there's a playtest survey available for you to fill out, so be sure to do so!

Thank you for your assistance, and enjoy your playthrough!

notes.title: DEVLOG #3 | 5 Months of Indie Game Dev
notes.notes:
Welcome back to another "Eons Away" development update! I'm thrilled to share with you a lot of new features I've been working on. Today's log includes an improved battle system with "Action Command" mechanics, a detailed skill tree for character development, and a bonding system with alignment consequences that add depth to your in-game choices.

Additionally, I've made significant strides in world-building with the introduction of a village hub that serves as the game's main area. We've also integrated a dynamic day and night cycle that affects gameplay mechanics and quest availability.

To further immerse you in our world, I've implemented a corruption system that visually reflects on characters and enemies. Plus, I've added various quality of life improvements and bug fixes.

I'm eager to hear your thoughts and look forward to engaging with you on our Discord channel for real-time updates and discussions. And don't forget to add "Eons Away" to your Steam wishlist to support the game!

notes.title: Eons Away - A New Website
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Exciting news - Eons Away now has a brand new website! As the creator of Eons Away, I'm thrilled to share this news with you and invite you to check it out for yourself. The website is now live at [url=http://EonsAway.com]http://EonsAway.com[/url], and I would love to hear your feedback on it.

Thank you for your continued support, and I hope to see you soon in the world of Eons Away!

notes.title: Name change! Eons away
notes.notes:
After careful consideration, I've decided to change the game's name from "Orya: Broken World" to "Eons Away". The new title better aligns with the story and vision of the game, and I'm very excited to share this new name with you all! I'll update the name across the internet in the coming weeks. 

Thanks for your continued support!!
